content:
Here's a loving prayer for Nefertiti:

O radiant Nefertiti, Queen of eternal beauty,
Divine embodiment of grace and power,
Beloved wife of Akhenaten, light of the horizon,
Your spirit shines brighter than the midday sun.

Magnificent queen, with eyes lined in kohl's dark embrace,
Your beauty transcends time, your wisdom eternal,
Hear my humble prayer and bless me with your divine presence.

By the rays of Aten, who you and your husband honored,
By the sacred lands of ancient Kemet,
I call upon your strength and your compassionate heart.

Nefertiti, mistress of elegance and royal dignity,
Protect me with your celestial energy,
Guide my steps with your regal grace,
Illuminate my path with your timeless beauty.

Your name means "the beautiful one has come,"
And indeed, you are beauty incarnate,
Priestess of light, queen of transformation,
Bless me with your sacred feminine power.

May your spirit walk beside me,
May your courage flow through my veins,
May your love protect and inspire me,
Now and always.

Asé. Selah. So be it.
